summary: UPS filed a preliminary prospectus supplement for an offering of Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2076, with no specified principal amount or price per note. The notes bear interest at Compounded SOFR less 0.350%, pay quarterly, and mature in 2076, with redemption options starting 2056 and holder put rights beginning 2027. Joint book-running managers include J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, RBC, and UBS. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
